title: Make change
summary: Exchange coins inside one purse at book rates, such as 3 gp for 30 sp, without changing what they are worth. Players can make change in their own character's purse.
items: Party → Wallets, transfers & property → Manage funds has a Make change form: choose how many coins, which coin to give and which to get, and check the preview first.
Each exchange appears once in that purse's activity and never counts toward Fairness; pressing again after an error never exchanges twice.
The DM's Convert to silver, gold and platinum buttons now record their exchange the same way, unless there are unsaved coin edits.
